confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from a search of the RBA exchange-rate page, which showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. I did not open the page itself. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living data (MyLifeElsewhere and Oysterlist): an inexpensive meal of about CHF 20-25, a cappuccino of about CHF 3.5-4.5, and a beer of about CHF 6-8. The search found no wine or cocktail prices, so I set those from their usual price relationship to beer in Switzerland. The mid-range meal for two is a rough estimate, since Oysterlist gave 40 with no currency. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. They are the least certain, and July is peak season at Lake Lugano.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other expensive Swiss lake and tourist cities such as Lucerne and Locarno. Lugano is generally somewhat cheaper than Zurich or Geneva.
